name: gnss_bias
basis: assumption: receiver position step (multipath or a bad satellite in the solution)

name: gnss_drift
basis: assumption: receiver position ramp rate (slowly growing satellite error)

name: baro_drift
basis: assumption: altitude ramp from a slowly leaking or icing port

name: noise_factor
basis: assumption: noise standard deviation multiplied by this factor (degraded unit)

name: common_mode_rate
basis: assumption: shared slowly growing error on both receivers (ionospheric-like)

name: common_mode_cap
basis: assumption: saturation of the shared error

name: fdi_offset
basis: assumption: position offset the attacker wants to induce

name: fdi_ramp
basis: assumption: time the attacker takes to ramp the offset in (rate limiting)

name: fdi_drag_acc
basis: assumption: acceleration of a drag-off (spoofer walking the solution away)

name: fdi_drag_duration
basis: assumption: duration of the drag-off acceleration phase
